<thought>Since the bond criteria caused an error, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group information for the forward reaction. This should return suitable templates, from which I can select the appropriate one and retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "molecule_smiles": "CCCCCCCCCCCO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
